entity.name: Briyan Hingarajiya
entity.description: Independent developer in India. I created and maintain Keyframery, a free, MIT-licensed library of animated UI components for React.

projects.name: Keyframery
projects.description: Keyframery is the component library for Vercel's UI SDK: 95 free, MIT-licensed components and two page templates (a landing page and an admin dashboard). UI SDK is Vercel's library of UI behaviours: keyboard, focus, selection, accessibility and a bridge that lets AI agents read and use your interface. Keyframery is the component library on top. Every component renders UI SDK underneath and adds a finished look and motion written in plain CSS, and the shadcn CLI (shadcn-vue for Vue) copies the code into your project, so it's yours. Every docs page also has a plain Markdown version so AI coding agents can read it. There is no paid tier.
